C as of April /4, 2004, between CHELSEA L. P., a New York Limited Partnership, having offices at c/o Palladia Inc.,10Astor Place,NewYork,NewYork 10003,and 595 RealtyLLC,a NewYork Limited Liability Company, having its principal place of business c/o Roeco at 46 Westchester Avenue,Pound Ridge, New York 10576 ("Transferee"); WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS,Transferor is the owner of certain land ("Transferor's Land") in the City of New York, and the buildings and improvements thereon ("Transferor's Building"), known as 105 West 17h Street,NewYork,New York, and known as Lot 32,Block 793 on the TaxMap (the"Tax Map") of the Real Property Assessment Department of the City of New York, and more particularly described in Schedule "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferor's Building being herein called "Transferor's Premises,"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certainland adjacent to Transferor's Premises ("Transferee's Land") and the buildings and improvements located thereon in the City of New York ("Transferee's Buildings"),known as595-603SixthAvenue and103West 17h Street,NewYork,New York, known as Lots 33, 35 and 37, Block 793 on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Scheduie "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land together with Transferee's buildings being herein called "Transferee's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to construct a new building and improvements on Transferee's Land (said building and improvements and any related improvements, additions thereto and replacements thereof being herein collectively called "Transferee's New Building"); and WHEREAS, Transferee's New Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as that termis defined in theZoningResolution(the"Zoning Resolution")of the City ofNewYork,effective as of December 15,1961,as amended from time to time,than is now availablefor use in respect of Transferee's Premises under the"floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution, with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combiningTransferee's Premises and,possibly other adjacent parcels, and Transferor's Premises,into a single"zoning lot" for the purpose of achieving compliance by Transferee's NewBuilding with such limitation (which procedure will make available toTransfereefor such purpose the Excess Development Rights attributable to the Transferor's Premises),(Excess Development Rights" shall mean the excess of all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Transferor's Land on the date hereof, over theFloorArea Development Rights appurtenant to Transferor's Land on the date hereof that are utilized byTransferor's Building on the datehereof; and Transferor and Transferee agree that as ofthe date hereof 8,792 squarefeet of floor area is utilized byTransferor's Building and further that Transferor is retaining an additional 1,237 square feet of floor area for community facility use (Transferor's Retained Development Rights); and WHEREAS,Transferee and Transferor are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering aDeclaration of Restrictions as defined in Section 12-10 of the ZoningResolution(the Declaration"),which makes such procedure available to Transferee for such purpose by creating a single zoning lot (the"Combined Zoning Lot") out of Transferee's Premises and Transferor's Premises;
